spec.doc: Current post-close grace window for Buy/Sell traces, in seconds.
spec.name: action_grace

spec.doc: #299: Paged list of affected trace ids starting from the first trace published at or after `compromised_since`.
spec.name: affected_traces

spec.doc: Current chain head for `agent` (genesis if it has never chained).
spec.name: agent_chain_head

spec.doc: Trace id at position `seq` (1-based) of `agent`'s chain.
spec.name: agent_chain_trace_at

spec.doc: The `index`-th (0-based, publish order) trace id for `agent` (#57).
spec.name: agent_trace_at

spec.doc: Number of traces published by `agent` (#57).
spec.name: agent_trace_count

spec.doc: Marks a trace as having backed an action, exactly once (#50). Only an allow-listed consumer contract can call it; the treasury passes its own address, which satisfies `require_auth` as the direct invoker.
spec.name: consume_trace

spec.doc: Extends an agent's `Identity` entries (registration, chain head, signing keys and up to `retention::MAX_EXTEND_KEY_HISTORY` history records) to the long-lived target. A no-op for unknown agents.
spec.name: extend_agent

spec.doc: Extends index entries `[from, to)` (clamped to the index length) and the index's count to at least the target of each referenced trace. At most `retention::MAX_EXTEND_INDEX` entries per call.
spec.name: extend_index

spec.doc: Extends every key of each trace (the trace plus its side keys) to its retention target. At most `retention::MAX_EXTEND_TRACES` ids; unknown ids are skipped. Returns the number of entries extended. Also bumps the instance, so archivist traffic alone keeps the contract live.
spec.name: extend_traces

spec.doc: Pure read (#329): views never extend TTL.
spec.name: get_signing_keys

spec.doc: Pure read (#329): views never extend TTL, so simulations have a read-only footprint. Retention comes from write-time targets and the archivist entrypoints (`extend_traces`).
spec.name: get_trace

spec.doc: Ledger sequence the trace was written in (#50). `None` for traces written before this field existed.
spec.name: get_trace_ledger

spec.doc: Chain link for a trace; `None` for legacy, unchained traces.
spec.name: get_trace_link

spec.doc: Read-only view: no TTL writes, so an indexer's simulation stays cheap. The `Agent` entry is refreshed by `register_agent`/`publish_trace`.
spec.name: is_registered

spec.doc: Whether a Buy/Sell trace was published after its market's close.
spec.name: is_trace_late

spec.doc: #299: Binary search for the first trace index whose `published_at >= compromised_since`. Returns the index, or `total` if none qualify.
spec.name: key_affected_from

spec.doc: #299: Number of traces a key has signed (length of the per-key index).
spec.name: key_trace_count

spec.doc: #299: Paged list of trace ids a key has signed.
spec.name: key_traces

spec.doc: The `index`-th (0-based, publish order) trace id for `(market_id, action)` (#57).
spec.name: market_action_trace_at

spec.doc: Number of traces for the `(market_id, action)` pair (#57).
spec.name: market_action_trace_count

spec.doc: The `index`-th (0-based, publish order) trace id for `market_id`.
spec.name: market_trace_at

spec.doc: Number of traces published for `market_id`.
spec.name: market_trace_count

spec.doc: The market rule of an allow-listed `Other(sym)` action.
spec.name: other_action_rule

spec.doc: Every allow-listed `Other` symbol.
spec.name: other_actions

spec.doc: The pending admin proposal, including its expiry, if one exists.
spec.name: pending_admin

spec.doc: Starts a two-step handover of the admin role. The new admin must call `accept_admin` itself, so a typo cannot hand control to an address nobody holds.
spec.name: propose_admin

spec.doc: Publishes a trace that extends `agent`'s hash chain (#52). Fails with `ChainHeadMismatch` unless `expected_seq == head.seq + 1` and `prev_trace_hash == head.head_hash`, so a skipped decision shows up as a gap and a fork is impossible.
spec.name: publish_chained_trace

spec.doc: Anchors a Merkle batch of N traces off-chain, storing only the 32-byte root and manifest CID on-chain (#54).
spec.name: publish_trace_batch

spec.doc: Allow-lists a contract (e.g. the treasury) to call `consume_trace` (#50).
spec.name: register_consumer

spec.doc: Revokes a signing key retroactively. Verdicts for traces the key signed at or after `compromised_since` flip to `KeyCompromised`. Callable by the agent or the registry admin, including for retired or revoked agents. Revocation is permanent; `compromised_since` can only move earlier on a subsequent call.
spec.name: revoke_signing_key

spec.doc: Sets the post-close grace window for Buy/Sell traces (issue #322), at most [`MAX_ACTION_GRACE_SECS`]. Admin only.
spec.name: set_action_grace

spec.doc: Adds, changes (`Some`) or removes (`None`) an allow-listed `Other(sym)` action (issue #322). At most [`MAX_OTHER_ACTIONS`] symbols; canonical action names are refused. Admin only. Applies at publish time only, so existing traces are untouched.
spec.name: set_other_action

spec.doc: #299: Returns the signature-level verdict for a trace, independent of hash/flag/agent checks. Uses a constant number of reads.
spec.name: signature_verdict

spec.doc: Reads the instance's `NextId`. Pure read (#329): the instance is kept alive by mutating entrypoints (and `extend_traces`), not by views.
spec.name: trace_count

spec.doc: A page of every trace `agent` published, in publish order (#57).
spec.name: traces_by_agent

spec.doc: A page of every trace for `market_id`, starting at `start` (#57). Replaces the `market_trace_count` + `market_trace_at` + `get_trace` loop (101 RPC simulations for 50 traces) with one simulation.
spec.name: traces_by_market

spec.doc: A page of every trace for `(market_id, action)`, in publish order (#57) — e.g. every `Buy` decision on market 7.
spec.name: traces_by_market_action

spec.doc: Checks a commit-reveal commitment (#51): `commitment == sha256("oracledesk.trace.commit.v1" || trace_hash || salt)`.
spec.name: verify_commitment

spec.doc: Head of an agent's append-only trace log (#52). Genesis is `seq = 0` with an all-zero hash.
spec.name: ChainHead

spec.doc: Which secondary index `extend_index` walks (#329).
spec.name: IndexKey

spec.doc: Market rule of an allow-listed `TraceAction::Other(Symbol)` (issue #322).
spec.name: OtherRule

spec.doc: A proposed admin handover (#62). Absent when no transfer is pending.
spec.name: PendingAdmin

spec.doc: #299: Verdict for a trace's signature alone (independent of hash/flag/agent).
spec.name: SignatureVerdict

spec.doc: A page of traces returned by one simulation, plus the cursor to fetch the next page (#57). `next == total` means the caller has seen everything.

fields.doc: Total entries in this index at read time.

spec.doc: One `(trace_id, Trace)` pair in a [`TracePage`].
